heading: •Tatooine: Mos Eisley (Dark) (V)
notes: Group: Blockade. Unique. Portrait SITE overlay printed sideways, both halves (not renamed: bars read '•TATOOINE: MOS EISLEY'; red • on the Dark (black) bar, dark • on the Light (silver) bar). Dark half (left column, black bar): ONE red Dark Force saber (the second Force slot below it is empty black) → dark_force true, single — the printed card has TWO Dark Force icons (no dark_force_count set). Light half (right column, silver bar): one blue Light Force saber. Icon boxes on both bars, outermost first: scomp ring, planet (Tatooine sphere), exterior (sky with two suns), interior (beige wall corner). Printed card: planet + exterior only, no scomp, no interior. Texts read by rotating the crop; ‘player’s’ curly. Printed Dark text was 'Your spies, thieves, bounty hunters and smugglers are each power and forfeit +1 here.'; printed Light half had no text. Stub text matches (it runs both halves together). Base scan 490×350 only; copyright Premiere 1995 by rule. Modern: VB1-D-tatooinemoseisley-pre.gif (Virtual Block 1, 490×353) — same texts and icons (shown from the Dark seat).
